svg.aria-label: 30-column breadboard: TinyFPGA BX straddling the trench with pins 1-7 in columns 2-8, a 1602A 16-pin header in columns 12-27, and a 10k pot. Jumpers wire BX 1 to LCD RS, 2 to E, 3 to RW, 4-7 to D4-D7, power to the rails, and the pot wiper to VO.
svg.text: Each column of 5 holes is one node. BX pins 1–7 in cols 2–8; LCD 16-pin header in cols 12–27. Pins verified vs BX.ice/pins.pcf.
